visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black blazer over a white t-shirt is seen from the back, erasing a whiteboard with a white eraser in his right hand. The whiteboard has blue and black marker handwriting on it. (2) The man turns around to face the camera, holding a marker in his left hand and the eraser in his right. He wears a black lanyard with an ID card. He looks directly at the viewer with a neutral, engaging facial expression. (3) He turns back to the whiteboard and begins writing numbers in black marker. He writes '1000', then '400' below it, and draws an arrow to '600'. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or office. (4) He continues writing, adding '100' and '60,000' while occasionally looking back at the camera to explain. The background shows some cardboard boxes stacked against a wall. (5) He erases part of the board and writes more complex calculations involving '900', '200', '180,000', and '+6萬 = 24'. He uses large hand gestures to emphasize his points. (6) He faces the camera fully, gesturing with both hands. He crosses his arms to form an 'X' shape, then points downwards with both index fingers toward the bottom of the frame where link information might appear. He smiles and appears enthusiastic.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Allen哥，代理商一年可以賺多少錢. (2) [Subtitle]: 真的想知道嗎?. [Variety]: 想啊!!. (3) [Subtitle]: 好那我跟你講，這還是要看你代理什麼產品. (4) [Subtitle]: 我算給你看! 譬如說一個產品售價是$1,000，那你進口成本是$400，那你一個產品可以賺$600，一個月我們賣100件就好了。. (5) [Subtitle]: 等於$60,000。. (6) [Subtitle]: 怎麼那麼少，才$6,0000，我們的目標不可能一個月只賣100件吧，我們一個月要賣1,000件。. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以剩下的900件給經銷商賣，所以我們給經銷商利潤，我們給他$600，他賣$1,000。. (8) [Subtitle]: 而我們成本$400，我們賺$200，900(件)x200(元)=$180,000。. (9) [Subtitle]: 18萬+6萬=一個月$240,000毛利。. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是我只賣100件，其他是給經銷商賣，這個就是我們跟一般零售不一樣的獲利模式。. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以我們的方法就是打團戰，自己會賣根本沒有用，要大家一起賣，然後才能把這市場做起來。. (12) [Subtitle]: 你只要專心在一個品牌，一個產品，把它賣大量，不是用上千樣的產品來去做大量的業績。. (13) [Subtitle]: 這完全是不一樣的邏輯，這樣有聽懂嗎? 趕快分享出去。. (14) [Subtitle]: 更專業的代理課程，可以到我即將要PressPlay上市的課程去觀看，我把連結寫在下方，先關注我的頻道。. [Logo]: PressPlay.
